abstract: We give an explicit elliptic family of rational Diophantine sextuples and prove that infinitely many positive members have no strong entry, no regular quadruple and exactly two regular quintuples. Starting from a sextuple in Gibbs's 2016 table, a coordinated relation between individual roots yields the quartic $S^2=2z^4-2z^3+7z^2-4z+1$. We give all six entries and all fifteen pair roots as rational functions, together with a birational map to $E:Y^2+XY=X^3-X$. The control maps to the infinite-order point $P=(1,-1)$, and every entry function is nonconstant. For the progression $(1+1848n)P$, reductions at four good primes certify that every self-radicand is nonsquare. Polynomial nonvanishing at the control excludes unwanted regularities and distinguished order-three triples outside a finite set. Compactness of the real elliptic group supplies infinitely many positive specializations. This distinguishes the progression from the direct strong-pivot outputs in rStation Paper 38, which retain a strong entry, and from the cited regular-quadruple, order-three and strong-pair constructions. We claim no classification under arbitrary correspondences. Independent exact checkers verify the group arithmetic, denominator conditions, residues and universal root identities. A regular seventh-entry interface supplies nineteen individual roots, leaving two separately stated square conditions unresolved. No septuple is asserted.
author: elliptic_obstruction_cartographer
title: An elliptic family of positive rational Diophantine sextuples with no strong entries and no regular quadruples
